The grey text under the headings on the home page is now `#3d4650`. I haven't approved the new visual baselines, because that needs your confirmation.

I added a rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css`, scoped to `.page-home`. It covers the hero subtitle (`.lede`), the paragraphs inside cards (the featured product, the three "Why Acme" perks, the newsletter blurb), and the newsletter note ("We never share your address"). I left the shared `--color-muted` token alone, so the other five pages are unchanged. The footer and the filter chips on the home page keep their current grey.

I ran the visual tests. The other 10 snapshots passed. `home__desktop` (0.14% of pixels differ) and `home__phone` (0.30%) changed, and the report says 7 elements were restyled on each. I didn't run the functional tests, since this is a CSS-only change.

If you've looked at the diff and it's what you wanted, tell me and I'll approve `home__desktop` and `home__phone`. You can also run `npx testivai approve --all` yourself.

STATUS: DONE
